Non esse curiosè inquirendum,
quænam illa fuerint, quæ Christus tacuit.
Tertium, Maiora esse existimat & occultiora, quàm quæ mens humana, etsi
Spiritu sancto illuminata, complecti & capere possit (in quo tamen erravit)
vt de prædestinatione, de numero electorum, de gaudiis regni cœlorum, &c.

eadem, quæ ipsi iactant, & in suis Traditionibus reponunt. Sed hæc illi
nunquam probare poterunt.
Secundum locus Scripturæ à Iesuita citatus, habetur in vltimo cap. Ioan.

page.notes: Page is a single column; no marginal notes. Greek word "ἀγραφα" as printed is uncertain. The final line "vltimis" is a catchword at the foot. Some words in italic-bold in the source are rendered in italics. Some letters are blurred, notably in "Quadragesima" and "Spiritu".
